info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 105 hours self-study (including projects preparation)
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptops in class only for learning purposes

- Read the theory in advance

- Use Gen-AI tools/ CAT tools in an appropriate and ethical manner
info.tools: Google Translate, ChatGPT, DeepL, Smartcat, Matecat, MemoQ, Trados, etc.

assessments.questionType: Students translate 01 English-Vietnamese text and 01 Vietnamese-English text of administrative, business, financial, technical, socio-cultural issues. The text length is 250 words
assessments.knowledgeSkill: Test the acquainted knowledge and translation skills which student obtained during the courseContent based on topics of studied units

assessments.questionType: Groups are assigned with 02 texts (SL: Vietnamese & English) translated by AI/ CAT tools. The topic revolves administration, business, finance, technology and engineering, and socio-culture.They then fully post-edit the AI/CAT-translated text for a target audience, paying attention to the register, style, terminology and context.Finally, they make a declaration of AI/ CAT use (how, where, and why)
assessments.knowledgeSkill: Test the acquainted knowledge and translation skills, using AI/ CAT tools critically, contextually and ethically(Students are required to evaluate and edit AI-generated translation)

assessments.questionType: (Students are assigned a translation project, either an authentic project or a simulation one, using AI/ CAT toolsGroups of 3-4 with different roles in a project: project manager, AI-human collaborative translators/ editors, chief editor)
assessments.knowledgeSkill: Human-in-the-loop editing, project management, cultural literacy, AI ethics

assessments.questionType: Translate texts given on the topics covered from Vietnamese to English and vice versa
assessments.noQuestion: 1 E-V text + 1 V-E text: 1. translating part 1 of each text; 2. full post-editing AI's translation for part 2 of each textLength of each text: 250 words + difficulty level.
assessments.knowledgeSkill: Test the acquainted knowledge and translation skills students obtain in the delivered in the course
